calculation.description: Negative three-day cumulative close-to-close return divided by three-day return volatility; higher values indicate stronger recent weakness on a risk-adjusted basis and are expected to mean-revert cross-sectionally. Signal uses only data through the completed signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and above admission gates in 2020-2022 (IC 0.051243, ICIR 0.160602, n=305), 2023-2024 (0.044770, 0.132615, n=200), and 2025-2027 sample through validation date (0.071078, 0.229014, n=261). Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
